agreements.title: Seller agreements
agreements.intro: Store terms, versions and evidence of approval.
agreements.name: Agreement title
agreements.languageHint: Text is shown in this language without automatic translation. Maximum 12,000 characters.
agreements.publishHint: Use the store's own terms. Komisio does not review their legal content. Published versions are preserved and cannot be edited.
agreements.requireEvidence: Require recorded approval evidence before receiving bags
agreements.confirmPublish: I reviewed the text and receiving requirement. This version should apply to future submissions.
agreements.none: No seller agreement is published. No new agreement prerequisite applies to receiving.
agreements.historyHint: The 20 latest versions. Older versions remain accessible from their receipts.
agreements.adminOnly: Owners and admins can publish agreement versions.
agreements.evidenceHint: Reference an approval that already exists outside Komisio. This is a staff record, not the seller's electronic signature.
agreements.referenceHint: For example: paper agreement TEST-12, or the date and reference of a retained email. Keep the original at the store. Avoid sensitive personal information.
agreements.confirmEvidence: I checked that this evidence concerns this seller and the displayed agreement version.
agreements.available: Evidence exists for the current version
agreements.missing: Evidence is missing for the current version
agreements.noReceiptAgreement: No agreement information was recorded with this receipt.
agreements.noEvidence: No evidence was linked to this receipt.
agreements.evidenceNote: The agreement record does not approve the contents for sale.

intake.title: Intake
intake.intro: Receive the bag now. Review its contents later.
intake.pilot: Pilot: receiving records that the store has the bag. Recorded agreement evidence is not an electronic signature. Item drafts can be saved during inspection; sales come later. No email is sent.
intake.name: Seller name
intake.contactHint: Enter at least an email or phone number. Check whether the seller already exists first.
intake.noSellers: No sellers found. Try another name or register a new seller.
intake.noteHint: For example: blue fabric bag. Avoid sensitive personal information.
intake.custody: I confirm that the store has received this bag. Its contents have not been inspected.
intake.saved: The bag is registered. You can now print its label.
intake.queueHint: 20 bags per page, highest bag number first. Open a bag to continue inspection. New bags may arrive while you browse.
intake.label: View label
intake.limit: Showing up to 50 sellers. Narrow your search if someone is missing.
intake.readOnly: You can view intake. Staff can register sellers and receive bags.
intake.invalid: Check the details and try again.
intake.agreementChanged: The agreement changed. Reload and review the current version before continuing.
intake.agreementRequired: The store requires evidence of seller approval of the current agreement before receiving.
intake.failed: Could not confirm the result. Retry with the same details. Check the list before starting again.
intake.changed: The active store changed. Reload this page before continuing.
intake.denied: You do not have permission. Reload the page to check your access.
intake.inspectionChanged: The draft changed after you opened it. Your edits remain here. Copy anything you want to keep before opening the current revision.
intake.inspectionUnavailable: The draft status changed or it can no longer be edited. Your input remains here. Open the current version before continuing.

tagline: More room for things to live again.
help: A trusted foundation for your second-hand store.
name: Name
loginIntro: Welcome back. Your store is waiting for you.
registerIntro: Start with your account. Then create a store or join through an invitation.
invitedRegisterIntro: You followed a store invitation. Create your personal account using the email address that received it. You do not need to create a new store. Already have an account? Use the sign-in link below.
invitedLoginIntro: Sign in with the email address that received the invitation. You will return here to accept it. New to Komisio? Choose Create account below.
verifySent: Check your email and follow the link to confirm your account. Open it in the same browser you used here. The link can only be used once.
resetSent: If the account exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your email.
authError: The request could not be completed. Check your details and try again.
callbackError: This link could not be used. Request a new link and open it in the same browser.
onboardingIntro: You become the owner and can invite colleagues next. You can work in several stores with the same account.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. For example my-secondhand.
homeIntro: Bring together the people and settings that keep your store running.
setupIntro: Build the foundation together with your team.
teamIntro: Give each colleague the right access, from viewing to administration.
foundationNote: Starting with the foundation. Intake, items and sales will follow in the next stage.
membersIntro: Manage who has access to the store and what they can do.
inviteIntro: The invitation is tied to the specified email address and expires in seven days.
removeConfirm: Remove this person's access to this store? Their account and other stores are unaffected.
roleConfirm: Confirm this change to the person's permissions.
inviteDelivery: Share the link with the recipient. Automatic email is not enabled.
inviteEmailAccepted: The invitation has been submitted for email delivery. You can also share the link below.
inviteEmailUnconfirmed: The invitation was created, but we could not confirm the email submission. Share the link with the recipient.
inviteEmailRestricted: This test environment only emails approved test recipients. You can share the link manually.
readOnlyMembers: You can see who works here. An owner or administrator manages permissions.
tenantIntro: The essentials that help your team find the right place.
tenantImmutable: This identifier distinguishes your store from other stores.
accountIntro: Your personal details follow you across stores.
mfaIntro: Protect your account with an authenticator app.
mfaScan: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app and enter the code.
mfaLoginIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
mfaRecovery: Keep your authenticator safe. Recovery of a lost factor requires help from the operator in this version.
inviteAcceptIntro: Accept using the same email address the invitation was created for.
inviteSwitchAccount: Wrong account? Sign out here and sign in with the email address that received the invitation. You will return to this link.
inviteRecovery: Open the latest invitation in your inbox. A new invitation replaces earlier links. Already accepted? Go to the overview. If it still does not work, ask the store administrator for a new invitation.
inviteLogin: Sign in or create an account to accept your invitation.
notFound: This page could not be found.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try loading the page again.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again and confirm your email address.
errors.INVITATION_INVALID: The invitation is invalid, revoked, already used or intended for another email address.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person already belongs to the store.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check your details and try again.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person no longer belongs to the store.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This identifier is already in use. Choose another.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The store must have at least one owner. Appoint another owner first.
errors.TENANT_CHANGED: The active store has changed. Reload the page before continuing.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.

inspection.title: Inspect the bag
inspection.pilot: Save item descriptions and continue later. Drafts are not approved for sale.
inspection.savedHint: This revision will be available when you return. It does not approve the item for sale.
inspection.saveHint: Save before leaving this page. Unsaved edits are lost on reload. Avoid personal information in descriptions.
inspection.reload: Open current revision (unsaved edits will be lost)
inspection.listHint: 20 drafts per page in a fixed order that does not change when a new revision is saved. New drafts can arrive while you browse.
inspection.emptyPage: No item drafts on this page. Return to the first page.
inspection.historicalHint: This revision is read-only. Open the current draft to make a new change.
inspection.historyHint: Saved revisions are preserved. Select a revision to see past details and compare them with the latest.
inspection.archiveHint: This applies to the last saved version. Save any description changes first. Archiving does not change what has happened to the physical item.
inspection.confirmStatus: I confirm the change to the draft status.
